auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to keep watch over your children.
auth.createAccountSubtitle: Join SIREN to protect your children.
auth.acceptTerms: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy
auth.forgotBody: Enter your account's phone or email and how to receive the code: we'll send you a code to choose a new password.
auth.acceptTermsA11y: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy
auth.resetDoneBody: Sign in with your new password. Your other devices have been signed out.
auth.resetSubtitle: If an account matches, a code has just been sent by {{channel}}. Enter it, then choose a new password.
auth.twofaSubtitle: Enter the code sent to {{destination}} to finish signing in.
auth.phoneHint: Required. Without a country code, +237 is added.
auth.emailOptionalHint: Optional. Once verified, it can also receive your codes.
auth.codeSentVia: Enter the 6-character code sent by {{channel}} to {{destination}}.

learn.title: SIREN learns your child's routine.
learn.body: Within a few weeks, the AI learns routines to quickly spot anything unusual.

alert.title: You are alerted as soon as they leave their routine.
alert.body: A clear risk score and explicit reasons, so you can react quickly and calmly.

layers.title: Protected from day one, sharper every week.
layers.body: Declared rules, universal detectors and personal learning combine with growing confidence.
